dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I don't see anything like the woven scrolls we have in Natlan around here. The books on the shelves are all fairy tales.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I don't think I can learn anything useful from this material...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hmm... Guess I'll just take a rock sample and analyze it back home.
